narrative.northStar: Record the purchase; return to the register.
narrative.overview: Native Material 3 controls express the approved minimal expense workflow. Account context, delivery state and real recent purchases lead; one Add expense action remains within reach.

rules.name: Accessible state
rules.body: Pending, offline and destructive states are labelled in words, never color alone.

dos: Use Material role colors and typography
Respect system text size, dark mode and Back
donts: Present synthetic transactions in the app
